core_obligations: Category equivalence (proof lines 6379-6392): c^* is an equivalence between invertible sheaves on Y and invertible sheaves on X trivial on the bridge C, with quasi-inverse c_* by the projection formula.

omega_X is trivial on the bridge (proof lines 6394-6403): the sequence 0 -> omega_C -> omega_X|_C -> O_{C cap X'} -> 0 from lemma-closed-subscheme-reduced-gorenstein and the degree count (the author marks it a small detail omitted) give deg(omega_X|_C) = 0, so omega_X|_C is trivial by lemma-genus-zero-pic.

Yoneda conclusion (proof lines 6405-6430): R^1c_*c^*N = 0 makes the diagram of the two H^1-dual functors commute over the equivalent categories; omega_Y and omega_X both represent the south-east arrow, so they correspond under c^* by the Yoneda lemma, i.e. c^*omega_Y = omega_X.
proof_roadmap: Set up the two categories of invertible sheaves (trivial on C on the X side) and prove c^* is an equivalence with quasi-inverse c_*.
Show omega_X lies in the subcategory via the restriction sequence and the degree count on the bridge.
Use the vanishing of R^1c_* on the subcategory to commute the H^1-dual functors with c^*.
Conclude by Yoneda that omega_X is the pullback of omega_Y.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the canonical sheaf under a bridge contraction (statement lines 6366-6371). The proof (lines 6373-6430) is a representability argument: an equivalence of invertible-sheaf categories with quasi-inverse c_*, the verification that omega_X is trivial on the bridge through the restriction sequence and a degree count, and a Yoneda conclusion over the commuting square of H^1-dual functors enabled by the vanishing of R^1c_*. H3: the orchestration of representability, the category equivalence and the Leray comparison is a genuine duality argument.
